selected-core.js is adapted from the existing local NS PriPara web patcher's
arcade-unrar-core.js. Only import/wasm URL locations changed.

rar-select.js first validates a selected file header and copies only that file's
bounded compressed range into memory. This decoder sees a synthetic one-member
RAR view made from the original header/body plus minimal main/end headers. It
does not scan/decode the rest of the archive and does not execute input code.

The caller supplies memory read/write callbacks instead of OPFS. Therefore the
new selected-file adapter does not require SharedArrayBuffer, FileReaderSync,
OPFS, crypto.subtle or a secure context. The root application runs it in its own
worker, which can be terminated on cancellation. Signals are checked before/
after awaited reads and at decoder callbacks; cancellation events in the same
worker cannot interrupt synchronous decoding until its task returns.

unrar.js, unrar.wasm and Extractor.js are unchanged from the pinned vendor files
documented in README.txt. The original decoder and MIT/UnRAR licenses remain.
